detail.the_registration_also_says: As the rule stands a trial is not expected to pass it. Each stand-in is drawn from a band on BOTH sides of what its neuron is expected to deliver over the answer, and nothing matches the control edits over the prompt or at the last position; so by the draw alone some of an edit's matched control edits are quieter than it at one of the places compared (most of them, where the edit's neurons are among the loudest of their layer), each of those is counted as moving as much, and the level allows almost none. What a pass should ask of its control edits is the owner's to settle (ROADMAP section viii); until then a trial read of record is expected to spend the edit's one trial on a verdict the rule has settled, not the edit.
